verdict.rationale: Foreloop is not itself a coding agent but a task/product-management layer, so serving an official MCP server is a valid axis; docs explicitly state Foreloop exposes an MCP endpoint at /api/app/public/v1/mcp over streamable HTTP requiring only a URL and API key, letting agents connect directly. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation that a third-party MCP client successfully connects, and more detail on tool/resource schema exposed via MCP.
